_doc: Assumptions for the demo city (greentwin/twin/city.py). The synthetic housing mix stands in for real EPC records until an EPC extract is available (needs EPC_API_TOKEN or p3's local extract); it is placed over real Manchester postcode districts but its small areas are synthetic (e.g. 'M14-03'), never real LSOA codes. Every value here is a labelled assumption unless a source is given. Loft insulation and low-energy lighting come from greentwin/score/priors.json (EPC register 25% sample, fitted by p3).
label: Synthetic homes over real postcode districts; illustrative mix, not census or EPC data

districts._status: assumption: illustrative house-type mix per district

housing._status: assumption: typical UK stock patterns, not fitted

customers._status: assumption: synthetic customer base over the synthetic homes

loan._status: assumption: slider; no rate is quoted as a fact

stress._note: Absolute bill threshold until P0 adds ONS small-area income (then: bill share of income).

packages._status: assumption: standard packages for the city view; feasibility rules (P5) refine them when built

tiers._doc: A = instant offer, B = desk check, C = survey first. From input provenance and the synthetic customer flags.
